subject: Reckoning for incremental capacity spike & settlement plan
messages:
From: Evan Park <evan@hearthapps.com>
To: sofia_ivanova@redwoodai.com
Cc: HearthApps Billing <billing@hearthapps.com>
Date: 2026-10-17T08:12:34Z
Subject: Unexpected spike — overage and renewal timing

Hi Sofia,

Quick note — we discovered a sizable uptick in inference hours across a new feature rollout last month. The usage export is attached (HearthApps_usage_export_2026-09.csv). It pushed us ~160% over our committed capacity for September. Our renewal is due next week and we'd like to reconcile the overage before signing the new term.

Can Redwood help with a one-off settlement and a path to expand our committed capacity (likely a 1.5x step up for 12 months)? We had a couple of follow-on questions:
- What would a one-time invoice look like (amount and description)?
- Can we amortize any credit against the first month of the new term?
- Do you need a PO or additional paperwork to finalize?

Attaching the usage CSV for your team to validate. We can jump on a quick call if that helps.

Thanks,
Evan Park
Head of Platform
HearthApps
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodai.com>
To: Evan Park <evan@hearthapps.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodai.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2026-10-17T10:03:02Z
Subject: Re: Unexpected spike — overage and renewal timing

Hi Evan — thanks for the CSV and the heads up. I reviewed the export and reproduced the spike on our side — looks like an onboarding job processed a higher batch size for ~48 hours.

Proposal (initial):
- One-time settlement invoice to cover the September overage: $14,250 (calculated as billed pay-as-you-go for excess tokens/hours).
- Apply a one-time credit of $4,250 against the first invoice of the renewed term (so net invoice today: $10,000).
- Move HearthApps to a 1.5x committed capacity tier for 12 months starting at renewal; monthly committed commitment and unit-price adjustments in the attached PDF.

Next steps I suggest: Ben can confirm the invoice workflow below. If HearthApps signs the attached settlement invoice (DocuSign link to follow) and issues a PO, we'll apply the credit on month one of the new term. If you prefer amortization over 3 months, we can do that as well; flag preference.

Ben/Laura — can you confirm the GL code and whether Finance prefers an amortized schedule or single credit? Also, confirm the final invoice PDF so I can send Evan the DocuSign link.

If helpful, I'm happy to take a quick 20-min call to walk through the numbers.

Best,
Sofia Ivanova
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodai.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodai.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwoodai.com>
Date: 2026-10-17T11:05:47Z
Subject: Re: Unexpected spike — overage and renewal timing

Sofia — saw the numbers. Quick notes from Finance:
- Confirmed excess charge calc = $14,250 (unit-rate 0.075 / inference-hour equivalent used for this customer).
- We can issue a single invoice for $10,000 net if HearthApps accepts the $4,250 credit applied immediately. Finance prefers single settlement for clean bookkeeping; amortization complicates revenue recognition.
- GL: Revenue code RDW-INFER-OVR-2026.

Attachment: proposed_settlement_invoice_78921.pdf (PDF stub). If we need to amortize, we can record a deferred credit schedule; let me know ASAP.

I'll queue billing to issue the invoice once Sofia confirms final language and we have Evan's PO (or DocuSign).

Ben
Director, Finance Ops
Redwood Inference
From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodai.com>
To: Evan Park <evan@hearthapps.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodai.com>, HearthApps Billing <billing@hearthapps.com>
Date: 2026-10-17T16:22:11Z
Subject: Re: Unexpected spike — overage and renewal timing

Evan — appreciate the quick turnaround. I've attached the settlement invoice PDF (proposed_settlement_invoice_78921.pdf) and routed it for e-sign via DocuSign: https://docusign.com/sign/ABCD-HEARTH-78921

Summary of the offer:
- One-time net settlement: $10,000 (after $4,250 credit).
- Credit applied to first invoice of renewed 12-month 1.5x capacity term.
- Start date for the new term will be the date on the signed DocuSign + receipt of PO.

If HearthApps prefers the credit spread across the first three invoices instead of a single credit, we'll need a short amendment for accounting — let me know which option you prefer. Once signed, Laura will schedule the capacity increase and Ben will issue the final invoice.

Thanks — I can hop on a 15-min call tomorrow morning if you want to go line-by-line.

Sofia
From: Evan Park <evan@hearthapps.com>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwoodai.com>
Cc: HearthApps Billing <billing@hearthapps.com>
Date: 2026-10-18T09:04:12Z
Subject: Re: Unexpected spike — overage and renewal timing

Sofia — thanks, we reviewed and are good with the one-time net settlement of $10,000 and the credit applied to month one. I signed the DocuSign envelope and routed a PO to billing@redwoodai.com (PO# HA-10294).

Please confirm receipt of the signed DocuSign and the PO so we can finalize the renewal and kick off the increased capacity.

— Evan
